newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan airline shares mixed after Haneda slots news.
newsitem.headline: Japan airline shares mixed after Haneda slots news.

text.p: Shares in Japanese airlines were mixed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Friday morning after the Transport Ministry's announcement on Thursday about the distribution of new slots at Tokyo's Haneda Airport.
By 0040 GMT, All Nippon Airways Co Ltd (ANA) was down 14 yen at 792 but Japan Airlines Co Ltd (JAL) was up two yen at 488.
Japan Air System Co Ltd (JAS) was unchanged at 6,850 yen.
Of the 40 new slots, 13 will go to JAS and 12 to JAL, whereas only nine will go to ANA. New airlines will get a total of six slots.

A third runway is due to open at the Tokyo International Airport at Haneda, which is mainly a domestic airport, later this month but the airlines will not be able to use the new slots until July, the ministry said.
